title: Crimson Echoes: Midnight Groove — Option 2 [ADK+ORCAS Clone: Keyframe-Critic + Omni Native Audio]
genre: 128 BPM Art-Deco Speakeasy Jazz-Funk, Syncopated Slap-Bass & Brass Groove (B Minor)
act1NarrativeSummary: Concept: This Zyvoriq production elevates the classic 1930s Art-Deco jazz-funk aesthetic with a razor-sharp 128 BPM, B Minor sonic landscape, featuring a dynamic 60-second narrative arc. We begin in an intimate, chiaroscuro speakeasy, evolving into a vast, rain-slicked city plaza. The styling emphasizes ivory chalk-stripe suits and feathered headpieces, complemented by 6-shot anamorphic cinematography and precise 8-count geometric choreography, ensuring a visually and sonically arresting experience..
